items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1962-01-04
items.q: Oh yeah, Lee Collins played the second trumpet with the band, with the elite band when I was playing with them for a while.

ctx.x: He mentioned him. What kind of trumpet did he play? He was good. Something like Kid Thomas? Well, I think he was better.

Did he play like anybody in particular? No. He made a lot of fancy stuff. He was something, I don't know, he started something I think on the order of Lee Collins. He had a drive. High note man or? He had high notes too. Lee, I know, could make a lot of it. Did you ever play with Lee Collins? Lee Collins? Oh yeah, Lee Collins played the second trumpet with the band, with the elite band when I was playing with them for a while. Who did you say the trumpet player in Olympia was? The trumpet player in Olympia was?…
I forget the man. The man. Yeah. The trumpet player in Olympia was? Who did you say the trumpet player in Olympia was?
